hypothesis: The action-side Manny neutral/bind-axis composition is not symmetric with the observation-side Manny-bind-to-canonical-SMPL recovery, so an absolute ProtoMotions joint target does not round-trip through the two adapters as the same canonical joint rotation before constraint-range adaptation.
supporting_runtime_evidence: E14 established that all 69 conditioned action scalars and all 23 decoded UE quaternions match the pinned ProtoMotions v2.3 contract, while the locked RealOnnxPolicy run still failed body linear speed, pelvis height, and root tilt.

E3 established exact Physics Control target publication/readback while the first active-standing trace showed that the action-side neutral/bind stage changed the decoded left-thigh target into a distinct Manny parent-relative target before protective range adaptation.

E13 showed that bypassing Manny constraint-range adaptation worsened the locked result from three failed criteria to six, increasing the information value of testing the upstream observation/action frame contract rather than more physics or range tuning.

The controlled-target plant has stood under the same fully simulated topology, so the remaining failure is consistent with a semantic target/observation mismatch rather than an incapable physical plant.
competing_explanations: The action and observation transforms are symmetric for every one-to-one mapped joint; the captured activation neutral is the correct Manny representation of ProtoMotions identity and all known-axis probes round-trip within tolerance.

The adapter is symmetric, but the checkpoint receives an incorrect root, heading, future-pose, velocity, or other observation semantic that causes it to emit physically unsuitable yet correctly decoded targets.
The full adapter contract is correct and this checkpoint/reference state does not contain a standing solution for the current initial condition.

expected_if_hypothesis_correct: The trace-on arm remains behaviorally identical to baseline, but at least one one-to-one mapped joint exceeds the locked angular tolerance when Proto identity, the actual decoded target, or a known-axis probe is composed into Manny and recovered through the observation-side bind calibration; the trace identifies the first stage and frame values responsible.
falsification_observation: The trace-on arm is behaviorally identical to baseline and every one-to-one mapped joint returns Proto identity, the actual decoded target, and each positive/negative X/Y/Z probe through the observation/action adapter round trip within the locked tolerance, with complete finite frame data and matching ownership.

semantic_contract.checkpoint_action_meaning: ProtoMotions v2.3 absolute three-DOF SMPL joint PD targets because mimic_residual_control is false
semantic_contract.observation_recovery: Current Manny parent-relative body rotation is compared with the synchronized Manny T-pose bind rotation and conjugated by the parent bind component rotation to recover the canonical SMPL joint rotation.
semantic_contract.action_composition: Decoded canonical UE joint rotation is conjugated by the cached Manny parent action-axis reference and left-multiplied onto the captured Manny policy-neutral parent-relative rotation.
semantic_contract.roundtrip_under_test: canonical Proto/UE local joint target -> Manny parent-relative target before range adaptation -> observation-side canonical joint recovery
semantic_contract.decisive_scope: the 19 controls with exactly one Proto action joint and one corresponding SMPL observation body; collapsed hand controls remain diagnostic only

locked_judges.support_rule: Instrumentation is neutral and at least one decisive joint's identity, actual decoded, or known-axis action-observation round trip exceeds 0.001 degrees with complete finite trace data.
locked_judges.falsification_rule: Instrumentation is neutral and all decisive joints' identity, actual decoded, and all known-axis action-observation round trips are at or below 0.001 degrees with complete finite trace data.

implementation_constraints: Add no target behavior, production default, activation-contract, serialization, locked protocol, threshold, physics, or target-publication change.
Capture the actual runtime bind seed, policy neutral, observation bind frames, decoded target, and composition outputs; do not substitute synthetic fixture values for runtime evidence.
The independent evaluator must be deterministic and must reject missing, non-finite, non-normalized, duplicate, or ownership-inconsistent trace entries.
Tests must validate round-trip invariants, frame ownership, ranges, malformed-input rejection, and metric publication rather than asserting a candidate production constant.
Run a fresh unchanged baseline beside trace-on using one clean commit and reused binary, record the raw artifacts and conclusion, then stop before any behavior experiment or promotion.
